title: Pulling off his shoes and trousers there on the chair before me so barefaced without even asking permission and standing out that vulgar way in the half of a shirt they wear to be admired like a priest or a butcher or those old hypocrites in the time of Julius Caesar
html_source: This quotation is a prime example of the expectations that men have toward women in relationships with unbalanced power dynamics implemented by the varying hierarchal roles assigned to women and men. As seen from the text, Hugh automatically assumes that he is entitled to a sexual encounter with Molly without gauging her feelings on the matter first.
